title: Standfolk overlay card
description: An approved Studio story taken to air, as the API returns it from POST /api/studio/stories/:id/air and in the on_air field of GET /api/match/demo/events. An integration contract for graphics systems; no real integration is claimed.

card_id.description: The synthetic match event the story is about.

version.description: Approval version in the Studio; each approval raises it.

short.description: Top line, for example GOAL 12′ · Youngho Go (VR).

long.description: Body copy, checked by the API against the evidence before it airs.

evidence.description: References of the facts the copy rests on.

valid_from_ms.description: Match clock of the moment; the card never shows before it.

engine.description: Who wrote the approved wording before any producer edit.
